description: This file defines a Perl class 'Coocook::Script::Dbck' that implements database integrity checks for the Coocook project. It includes methods for schema validation, relationship consistency, SQLite-specific value checks, and other data integrity verifications.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Dbck
classes.description: A Perl class implementing database integrity checks for the Coocook application, including schema validation, relationship consistency, and data correctness checks.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a series of database integrity checks including schema, relationships, numeric values, FC values, URL name values, and unit conversions.

methods.name: check_schema
methods.description: Validates the database schema against an in-memory schema definition, comparing SQL for each table.

methods.name: check_relationships
methods.description: Verifies that related tables have consistent project IDs, ensuring referential integrity across multiple tables.

methods.name: check_sqlite_numeric_values
methods.description: Checks for empty string values in numeric columns and invalid number formats in SQLite databases.

methods.name: check_fc_values
methods.description: Detects duplicate organization/user FC names and verifies that 'name_fc' fields match the 'name' fields after applying 'fc' normalization.

methods.name: check_url_name_values
methods.description: Validates that 'url_name' and 'url_name_fc' fields match the expected URL-safe versions of the 'name' field.

methods.name: check_unit_conversions_values
methods.description: Checks for non-normalized rows in the 'unit_conversions' table where 'unit1_id' is greater than 'unit2_id'.

methods.name: _debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information if debugging is enabled.
